items.title: Expedia (NASDAQ:EXPE) posts better-than-expected sales in Q3 2026 but stock drops
items.summary: Online travel agency Expedia (NASDAQ:EXPE) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 11.9% year on year to $4.94 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $3.72 billion, close to analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $9.39 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
